#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, B;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &B);
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        scanf("%d", &a[i]);
    }

    std::vector<int> costs;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd) {
            costs.push_back(std::abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    std::sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

    int sum = 0, answer = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        sum += cost;
        if (sum > B) {
            break;
        }
        ++answer;
    }

    printf("%d\n", answer);
    return 0;
}
